pairs.evidence: features/labs/rentgen/terminalModel.ts:2 Here "terminal" is only a visual metaphor: a pure view model with no server or DOM that renders a verified-only money graph, a ledger and a styled "tail -f" provenance log. No PTY, emulator, multiplexer or interactive session exists here, and a case-insensitive search for node-pty, xterm, tmux, pseudo-terminal and scrollback across features/labs/rentgen/, features/** and package.json found nothing.

techniques.evidence: features/labs/rentgen/VariantRentgen.tsx:13 The "tail -f" log is a rendered list of provenance rows, not a pseudo-terminal stream, so there is no PTY whose resize or platform quirks would need managing.
